explication: Colibrì is a local inference engine and dashboard for running large open models on ordinary hardware, with expert weights placed across RAM, disk, and optionally GPU memory. The main user workflow is setup and model selection, then a chat or image request through the dashboard or compatible HTTP gateway to an engine and a generated result. The README also documents decision-model use, runtime monitoring, and expert visualization. Several runtime relationships are supported only by README statements or import references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
